guide.what_they_sell: Custom AI assistants and automated workflows built on n8n that respond to website customers 24/7 in any language.
guide.audience: Small-to-medium business owners, local businesses, and entrepreneurs losing leads due to slow website response times.
guide.language: English (with occasional Romanian posts for local events like Craiova Hackathon)
guide.tone: Direct, practical, results-driven, urgent, and professional.
recurring_topics: Slow website response times losing leads
The cost of manual data entry and busywork
Debunking the myth that AI requires complex tech teams
best_performing_patterns: Event coverage and community engagement (e.g., Craiova Hackathon posts)
Relatable pain-point hooks addressing lost leads at night or after hours
Short, punchy Reels with strong visual context or behind-the-scenes footage
hook_examples: Most website visitors leave if they do not get an immediate answer.
Your website gets traffic every single day, but most visitors vanish before you even know they were there.
La 02:47, un client îți vizitează site-ul și întreabă ceva.
guide.cta_style: Simple and direct, often including contact email (contact@velosyntech.com), website (velosyntech.com), and relevant event tags (@craiovahackathon).
guide.visual_notes: Clean corporate-to-startup style featuring event footage, human faces speaking to camera, text overlays with high-contrast text, minimalist backgrounds, and subtle branding.
do: Focus heavily on the pain of delayed responses and lost revenue
Keep text overlays clear and easy to read on mobile
Include direct contact information and website in captions
dont: Use overly technical jargon without explaining the business benefit
Make captions overly fluffy or conversational without a core problem-solution dynamic
Ignore local tech events and networking opportunities
